title: Derpy Items
description: This resource packs give tons of items derp faces.
body:
### Derpy Items
This is a resource pack that gives over 110 items awesome derp faces. If your tired of the old textures of items and want to make them more fun then download this pack.

### How to use
1. Download the resource pack
2. Put the .zip into your resource pack folder in windows key + R then type: "%appdata%.minecraft/resourcepacks" in the little box or load minecraft and drag it into the resource packs tab
3. Enjoy the nice derpy items
